_doc: GARUDA-FILIERA Batch A Lot 10 (A-L10) cure spec — conductor gate research/operations/2026-07-21-kbli-batch-a-lot10-conductor-gate.md. Closes the LAST 6 codes of Batch-A's originally-scoped 114-code sweep (93111, 93112, 93114, 93119, 93191, 93193), split into two dispositions determined at Lot 8/Lot 9's own gates and mechanically executed here now that the tier-scoped partial_detach primitive exists (PR #2921, 2026-07-21). 3 codes (93111, 93112, 93119) are INNOCENCE CONTROLS, certified clean, EXPLICITLY EXCLUDED from this spec — no entry, no fix, see the gate report's Innocence-controls section; their prior 'quarantined' label was a tooling artifact (derive_fiktif_positif.py Rendah/Menengah-Rendah formula-coverage gap for 93111/93119, and a derived_license mis-listing for 93112 corrected in PR #2920), never a record defect. The other 3 (93114, 93191, 93193) are cured here using the new action:'partial_detach'+tier_selector primitive (93114, 93191 — each has exactly one genuinely sound tier that must survive byte-identical) or a plain full detach (93193 — after removing its one contaminated tier, its OWN remaining tier is independently unconfirmable too, so nothing sound is left to preserve). 93191/93193's status_mapping/whatChanged were already corrected to MATCH_CON_AGGREGAZIONE at Lot 9 (batch_a_lot9.json, action:'metadata_only') — this spec does not touch those fields again, only per_skala.
_provenance: Adjudication already complete before this spec was authored — no new D1/D5 Workflow lane run for this lot. 93114's tier split + Tier-1-sound/Tier-2-absent finding: Lot 8 gate report research/operations/2026-07-20-kbli-batch-a-lot8-conductor-gate.md §3.4 (own PP28 row 394946 p.182 no.47 for Tier 1, image-verified, text explicitly excludes golf facilities; Tier 2 'Fasilitas Lapangan Golf' zero PP28 backing) + §5 open item 2 (tier-scoped detach primitive missing, filed PENDING-ARMS). 93191/93193's tier-scoped payload_cross_contamination finding: Lot 9 gate report research/operations/2026-07-20-kbli-batch-a-lot9-conductor-gate.md §2.1 (93191 Tier 1 = own 'Promotor Kegiatan Olahraga' activity, PP28 row 51 image-verified pp28/394946_p186-186.png; 93191 Tier 2 = byte-identical to 93193's own tier, foreign 'Aktivitas Perburuan' content; 93193 Tier 1 = byte-identical to 93191's own tier, foreign 'Promotor Kegiatan Olahraga' content; 93193 Tier 2 = own 'Aktivitas Perburuan' activity name but zero PP28/OSS backing anywhere in the 21-file/11,208-page vault, Kimi K3 red-team F2 correction — 93193 has ZERO genuinely sound tiers) + §3.2 (both codes held un-cured on per_skala pending the tier-scoped primitive, PENDING-ARMS L8 §3.4/§5.1b second confirmed instance). 93111/93112/93119 innocence disposition: Lot 8 gate report §3.5 (clean own-code crosswalk + fully image-verified PP28 licensing rows: 93111 p.178 row 44, 93112 p.179 row 45, 93119 p.186 row 50) + this session's regulatory research (NotebookLM NB-3, PP28/2025 Pasal 8(1) elucidation, verbatim: 'perolehan PB secara otomatis... berlaku bagi kategori tingkat Risiko usaha rendah dan menengah rendah' — confirms the fiktif_positif derivation-formula's Menengah-Tinggi/Tinggi-only scope is regulatorily correct, not a gap; Rendah/Menengah-Rendah tiers get automatic issuance via a different legal mechanism, and canonical's pre-existing fiktif_positif=true on those tiers is a documented, deliberately-preserved legacy artifact per derive_fiktif_positif.py's own docstring, same disposition as Lot 9's innocence controls 46201/96300 §2.4/§3.3) + PR #2920 (93112's derived_license quarantine-listing correction — perizinan is explicitly non-empty on 93112, so derived_license never applies to it per the D5_SCHEMA field description, it should never have been listed as an inventory entry needing verification). Tier-scoped primitive: PR #2921 (kbli/cure-tier-scoped-detach), scripts/kbli_filiera/cure_canonical_collisions.py action:'partial_detach' + tier_selector (content-matched, skala_usaha compared as a set, never by array index). Canonical pin at spec-authoring time: sha256 96a5ccec8f2fd65aeff591a30baa8bf177a16746b3939e02b572a8bf597cf2b3 (commit a99ecef55c, post-PR-#2920, pre-Lot-10-cure) — this lot's 3 codes' pre-cure per_skala independently content-verified against a fresh worktree checkout off origin/main at that commit (W88 discipline: content check, not sha proxy).

codes.data_note: action: partial_detach — only the Tinggi-risk tier (Menengah/Besar scale, golf-course-specific 'Fasilitas Lapangan Golf' scope) is moved into the disputed key; the Menengah Rendah tier (Mikro/Kecil/Menengah scale) is left completely untouched in per_skala, byte-identical. Confirmed two-tier record (Lot 8 gate report §3.4): Tier 1 (Mikro/Kecil/Menengah, Menengah Rendah risk) is fully verified — own PP28 row (394946 p.182, no.47) matches verbatim, and that row's own text explicitly excludes golf facilities ('...dan sejenisnya KECUALI Lapangan Golf'). Tier 2 (Menengah/Besar, Tinggi risk, Menteri/Kepala Badan authority, 'Fasilitas Lapangan Golf' kewajiban scope) has zero PP28 backing captured anywhere in the dossier — Lot 8 held this code entirely un-cured because cure_canonical_collisions.py had no per-tier selector (Lot 8 PENDING-ARMS §3.4/§5.1b); that primitive now exists (PR #2921, action: partial_detach + tier_selector, 2026-07-21) and is applied here for the first time program-wide. Forcing a whole-array detach (the only option Lot 8 had) would have destroyed Tier 1's genuinely-sourced, verified data — the tier-scoped selector avoids that trade entirely. pp28_sources=['93114'] (self-referential, own-code) is untouched — only the per-tier CONTENT was disputed, not the source citation.
codes.whatYouNeed:
**Mikro/Kecil/Menengah scale**: Medium-Low risk (Menengah Rendah). NIB + Standard Certificate, issued automatically — this tier's licensing is confirmed against the official PP28/2025 regulation text (own-code row, image-verified, explicitly excludes golf facilities).

**Menengah/Besar scale (golf-course-specific "Fasilitas Lapangan Golf" facilities)**: this tier's licensing information could not be confirmed against the official 2025 regulation text — an exhaustive search of the full regulation did not turn up the specific row this tier's risk classification, process (NIB + Izin), or authority were supposedly based on. This tier's licensing rows have been removed until a verified source is found; treat any Bali PMA-moratorium-exemption claim tied to this scale as unconfirmed too, since it depends on the same unverified risk classification.

**PMA:** Nationally fully open — 100% foreign ownership allowed.

Before registering or investing, confirm the current requirements with the Bali Zero team.

codes.data_note: action: partial_detach — only the foreign-activity tier (Kecil/Menengah/Besar scale, 'Aktivitas Perburuan' kewajiban content — 93193's own activity, not 93191's) is moved into the disputed key; the sound tier (Mikro/Kecil/Menengah/Besar scale, 'Promotor Kegiatan Olahraga' kewajiban content — 93191's own activity, PP28 row 51 image-verified pp28/394946_p186-186.png) is left completely untouched in per_skala, byte-identical. Confirmed tier-scoped payload_cross_contamination (Lot 9 gate report §2.1/§3.2): the two tiers this record carried were byte-identical to 93193's own two tiers — each code carried exactly one foreign-activity tier belonging to the other. Lot 9 held per_skala completely untouched (action: metadata_only, only a status_mapping/whatChanged correction applied) because cure_canonical_collisions.py had no per-tier selector (Lot 8 PENDING-ARMS §3.4/§5.1b, second confirmed instance there); that primitive now exists (PR #2921, action: partial_detach + tier_selector, 2026-07-21) and is applied here. status_mapping (MATCH_CON_AGGREGAZIONE) and intel_2026.whatChanged were already corrected at Lot 9 and are NOT touched again by this entry — only per_skala changes this lot. intel_2026.whatYouNeed is deliberately left untouched: the retained sound tier already covers the full skala_usaha range (Mikro/Kecil/Menengah/Besar) at the same risk/authority/process terms (Menengah Rendah, NIB dan Sertifikat Standar, Bupati/Walikota, Otomatis) the removed tier described for a narrower scale subset (Kecil/Menengah/Besar) — no client-facing licensing detail is lost by the removal, so no honest-gap rewrite is needed here.

Confirmed tier-scoped payload_cross_contamination (Lot 9 gate report §2.1/§3.2): Tier 1 (Mikro/Kecil/Menengah/Besar scale) is verbatim byte-identical to 93191's own correct tier, naming 'Promotor Kegiatan Olahraga' (sports-event promoter activity) — an activity 93193 has nothing to do with. Tier 2 (Kecil/Menengah/Besar scale) correctly names 93193's own activity ('Aktivitas Perburuan', hunting activities) but has NO PP28 row anywhere in the 21-file/11,208-page vault (pp28/ABSENT.json) and no OSS endpoints either — 93193 has ZERO genuinely sound tiers (Lot 9 gate report §2.1, Kimi K3 red-team F2 correction). Lot 9 held per_skala completely untouched (action: metadata_only, only a status_mapping/whatChanged correction applied) pending a per-tier selector that now exists (PR #2921, 2026-07-21) — but unlike 93191 (which keeps one genuinely-sound tier via partial_detach in this same spec), 93193 has nothing left to preserve once the contaminated Tier 1 is removed, since its own Tier 2 is independently unconfirmable against any PP28/OSS source (Lot 9 gate report explicitly predicted this: 'the likely end-state once it lands is full detach (both tiers unconfirmable), not a partial cure'). Cure: plain full detach (default action, no per-tier selector needed) — both tiers moved verbatim to the disputed key, per_skala -> []. status_mapping (MATCH_CON_AGGREGAZIONE) and intel_2026.whatChanged were already corrected at Lot 9 and are NOT touched again by this entry.

_innocence_controls_note: 93111 (Fasilitas Stadion), 93112 (Fasilitas Sirkuit), 93119 (Pengelolaan Fasilitas Olahraga Lainnya) are EXPLICITLY EXCLUDED from this spec — genuinely clean per Lot 8 D1+D5 (own-code crosswalk + fully image-verified PP28 licensing rows, gate report §3.5) and this session's PP28/2025 Pasal 8(1) regulatory research (NB-3). Their prior 'quarantined' label is a tooling artifact: 93111/93119's fiktif_positif=true on Rendah/Menengah-Rendah tiers has no citable derivation-formula locator because derive_fiktif_positif.py's formula table legitimately only covers Menengah-Tinggi/Tinggi tiers (a different legal mechanism — automatic issuance — applies at Rendah/Menengah-Rendah, per PP28/2025 Pasal 8(1) elucidation), and 93112's derived_license was never applicable in the first place (perizinan already stated, non-empty) so it should never have been listed as an inventory entry needing verification (corrected PR #2920). Do NOT add these three to this spec without a fresh adjudication — see the Lot 10 gate report's Innocence-controls section for the full reasoning, mirroring Lot 9's own innocence-control disposition for 46201/96300 (§2.4/§3.3 of the Lot 9 gate report).
